prior_summary: Grasp-frame transport with explicit detachment, implemented as an action-indexed geometric reference denoiser conditioning a learned joint-action DDPM. Separate red and blue future object poses, a free TCP reference, causal attachment probabilities and a learned two-observation grasp-transform filter provide offset-compensated TCP references. Masked prediction losses teach rigidity only across inferred held intervals, not during empty retreat.
applicable_conditions: Approximately rigid top-down cube grasps with reliable world TCP/block poses, goals and Panda joint/finger state. Train and invoke over the complete expanded delivery slices, including open-finger low approach, closure, partial lift, transport, lowering, release and disengagement. Both object streams are retained because the forward API has no explicit requested-object ID; selection must be compatible with the observed manipulation context. Two causal states support a local attachment estimate, not verified contact.
termination_guidance: Assess the original one-observation red_at_goal AND blue_at_goal contract using full rotated XY containment and the supplied height tolerance. Release, TCP clearance, velocity and sustained hold are not additional task predicates. Separately, useful red-to-blue readiness is red resting on its pad, fingers opening or open and TCP separating then moving high toward blue; terminal blue readiness is both blocks on pads with an open, retreated TCP. Continue this model through release/retreat when those interface states are needed, or transfer within the measured overlap to a successor that supports finishing the still-loaded transition.
limitations: The fixed sampler diffuses eight normalized actions, not a separate pose trajectory. Geometric references are learned clean-state reconstructions at each action noise level and condition action epsilon prediction; there is no independently sampled pose DDPM. No analytic IK, robot FK, force model, hard collision/containment constraint, image encoder, guaranteed equivariance, explicit role input or tested failed-grasp recovery is implemented. Attachment pseudo-labels and soft gates require calibration beyond successful demonstrations. A state-conditioned bypass permits the action decoder to underuse the prior; benefit must be tested by ablation.

config.segmentation: All 24 assigned M1_v2 expanded slices, unchanged, with both incoming and outgoing overlaps included.
config.normalization: Provided complete-original-demonstration limits normalizer; no refit. Relative translation features and losses use its TCP XYZ half ranges. Quaternion components have unit bounds.
config.offset_filter: Learned convex weighting of two observed TCP-inverse times object transforms per object, with sign-aligned quaternion averaging.
config.coupling_gate: Current attached probability times predicted future attached probability for each object; remaining mass uses free TCP. Re-estimate the offset on every invocation.

training_recipe.selection: Last EMA at the predeclared budget; no performance-based selection.
